description: This file contains the server-side code for the EditExam page in an online examination system. It primarily handles button click events to transfer control to other pages such as admin panel, profile, leaderboard, and exam editing pages.

classes.name: EditExam
classes.description: Code-behind class for the EditExam ASP.NET Web Forms page, handling initialization and button events.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Event handler for when the page loads. Currently does nothing.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Handles the 'home' button click event, redirecting user to the Admin Panel.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Handles the 'profile' button click event, redirecting to the Admin Queue page.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Handles the 'leaderboard' button click, redirecting to the Admin Leaderboard page.

methods.name: eTheoryB_Click
methods.description: Handles the button click for editing theoretical questions, redirecting to EditTheory page.

methods.name: eMcqB_Click
methods.description: Handles the button click for editing MCQ questions, redirecting to EditMCQ page.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Handles the logout button click, redirecting to the Login Page.
